mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current FEDFUNDS at 1.69% is below 2.0% threshold
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current UNRATE at 3.9% is below 4.0% threshold
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
